title: Cipher rebrands to Cipher Digital, plans to sell Bitcoin treasury
summary: Cipher Mining (NASDAQ: CIFR) rebranded Cipher Digital, as announced in its Q4 2025 Earnings call. The firm reported $60 million in revenue and a $55 million adjusted net loss for the fourth quarter on Tuesday as the miner continues to transition to an AI/HPC data center developer.
